end.parentNote: Manav practised what common animals eat and built food chains with arrows. They correctly gave chains such as grass → deer → lion and algae → larvae → fish, and explained that grass makes its own food. Food categories need another round of practice; at home, ask Manav to sort a few animals by what they eat and draw arrows from food to eater.
